jobs.description:
Are you a bit of a neat freak, strong in leading others, and do you also enjoy getting work done yourself? Then come join our team as an Assisting Housekeeping Supervisor at Hotel V Nesplein!

We are Conscious Group! Conscious Group consists of nine hotel, four Hotel V locations and five Conscious Hotels locations, and two restaurants. Here, hospitality, design, and sustainability come together. Conscious Hotels focuses on sustainability down to the smallest detail, without compromising on comfort. While Hotel V is known for its stylish, characterful, and authentically Amsterdam vibe. Within Conscious Group, all locations work together as one team, driven by our FOCAL values: Fun, Open, Connect, Ambition, and Love. And right now, Hotel V Nesplein is looking for an assisting housekeeping supervisor.

Are you someone who gets going early in the morning, keeps a clear overview, has a keen eye for detail and likes to have a steady schedule? Then we're looking for you! We're searching for an Assisting Housekeeping Supervisor who not only leads the team but is also hands-on and ready to roll up their sleeves.

Our housekeeping team is small and close, playing a key role in our guests' overall experience. Together with the team, you make sure every room and space is exactly right — fresh, well-kept, and finished down to the last detail. This means you have a direct impact on how guests experience their stay. You actively work on the floor, keep an overview, and jump in wherever needed. Early shifts or weekend work don't faze you, and you know how to go the extra mile for guests with a smile. If you live in Amsterdam and already have some hotel experience, that's a big plus.
